producer_report.summary: Added docs/ontology.toml with seven terms (planning, job, Athena, Hermes, product versus system, landed, Sri). Each term has a definition, the misread that added it, sources and relations. The file states the rule that a term is added only when it causes a misread. It also describes how a check reads it. Added crates/athena-cli/tests/ontology.rs, which validates the file and has unit tests on in-memory input for the failure cases. Added decision D109 to docs/decisions.md and a CHANGELOG.md entry. I did not touch most other listed deliverables (the other docs, Cargo files, xtask test), because the work did not need them.

checks_run.note: Full workspace run, no failures. The only ignored tests are the repository's own.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/ontology.toml exists with the seven seeded terms (planning, job, Athena, Hermes, product versus system, landed, Sri). Each has a definition, the misread that caused it, a source naming a path or decision id that exists in the repo (planning: BRIEF.md addendum 2026-10-16 'Speed, planning first' and D105; job and Athena: addendum 2026-10-17: Olympus; Hermes: Part 2 S1; product versus system: the Olympus relay note), and relations whose targets are all defined terms.
criteria_check.evidence: Read docs/ontology.toml: seven [[term]] entries, each with definition, misread, sources, relations. Planning cites the BRIEF.md 2026-10-16 heading and D105. Job and Athena cite the 2026-10-17 Olympus heading. Hermes cites the BRIEF.md heading 'S1. Instances and independence'. Product versus system cites the Olympus heading. Every relation target is one of the seven names. The test the_ontology_file_passes_its_structure_check checks the paths, headings, decision ids and relation targets and passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The file states that a term is added only when it causes a misread, and says how a check reads it (the parse path and fields). The landed term says merged on main through a verified pull request. The Sri term says to use the name or 'they', never he or she, and cites job 20261017-173504-91ys.
criteria_check.evidence: The file header and [ontology].rule state the rule and the field list. The landed definition begins 'Merged on main through a verified pull request'. The Sri definition says to refer to Sri by name or as they, never he or she, and names job 20261017-173504-91ys. The test the_ontology_states_its_rule_and_the_pronoun_and_landed_definitions passes.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md has a new entry keeping the ontology, citing the Olympus 2026-10-17 decision sheet (decision 5), listing alternatives (no ontology; per-study glossaries only), and stating that studies keep their own concept model so firstmate, Hermes Agent and Athena are compared in the same terms. Any decision-link or index file the repo requires for new decisions is updated.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the diff: D109 cites the decision sheet and addendum, lists alternatives (a) and (b) plus a third, and states the studies' concept model sentence. docs/decision-links.toml has no D10x entries, so nothing is required there, and the full cargo test passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a new test parses docs/ontology.toml and passes, and the test is written to fail on a missing or non-existent source, a dangling relation target, or a duplicate term (negative cases covered by unit tests on in-memory input). `cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test ontology gives 10 passed. These include a_missing_source_is_a_problem, a_source_that_does_not_exist_is_a_problem, a_dangling_relation_target_is_a_problem and a_duplicate_term_is_a_problem, which run on in-memory input. The full cargo test --locked, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check all pass.

criteria_check.criterion: No secrets or personal data, including the user's email address, appear in any new or changed file.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the new and changed files; no email address, credential or personal data appears. The file uses only Sri, they and job ids.

open_issues: The brief lists docs/architecture.md, docs/ontology.md, xtask/tests/ontology.rs, crates/athena-cli/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock as expected deliverables. I did not change them because the change did not need them.
mistakes: My earlier report left criteria 1 and 4 out of criteria_check or not shown as met. The work itself was complete and passing.
learnings: docs/decision-links.toml has no entries for recent decisions (no D10x), so a new decision needs no link entry.
The test crate already had toml and serde available, so no Cargo changes were needed.
